sentences.japanese: 君が黙っているのを見ると私の答えでは不満なのだね。
sentences.english: I take it from your silence that you are not satisfied with my answer.

sentences.japanese: 我々は人が飢えるのを黙って見ていられない。
sentences.english: We cannot stand quiet and watch people starve.

sentences.japanese: 何故君はその間ずっと黙っていたのですか。
sentences.english: Why were you silent all the time?

sentences.japanese: どうしてずっと黙ってたの？
sentences.english: Why were you silent all the time?

sentences.japanese: 何を言っていいのか分からなかったので、彼は黙っていた。
sentences.english: Not knowing what to say, he remained silent.
